title: How he practiced while working nights
summary: He practiced long notes and exercises but could not do much while working nights.

I was going to ask, when you practiced, did you used to have any certain way to practice at home when you were playing, or did you ever practice at home when you were working every night? I guess you didn't bother. Well, no.

Like on long notes or scales or something at home or not? Yeah, well, I used to practice long notes and exercises, try to practice exercises. But when I was working at night, I didn't get to do too much practicing because most of the time, after getting off, you'd run around in the up and sleep so late. That's right, yeah. You don't feel like it's not the same. Yeah. And so that way I didn't get a chance to work on practice like I should, but I did find times sometimes to get into practice. And then sometimes on a job, we'd get playing shows and get something in there that you couldn't work on. Then I'd take a little something and write it off and take it into practice and work it out at home. But, uh...
